what: Hand labels for a seeded sample of trials where the structured minimumAge field and an age floor parsed out of the eligibility prose disagree.
who: Labelled by the repository author by reading the criteria text around each match. These are judgements, not registry data, and they are recorded here so the claim in the README can be checked rather than taken on trust.
how: sample = random.Random(7).sample(disagreements, 40), plus the first 12 disagreements in corpus order and 6 seen while categorising. Duplicates removed.

labels.real: The prose states the trial's own minimum age and it genuinely differs from minimumAge.
labels.cohort_disjunction: One of several alternative routes into the trial ('Age >=70, or 60-69 if ineligible for X'; 'Cohort C: Age >=18').
labels.about_another_person: The age belongs to a parent, guardian, caregiver, donor or study facilitator, not the subject.
labels.sub_condition: The age gates some other criterion: which performance scale to use, how menopause is defined, a lab cutoff, when assent is needed, a risk-factor list.
labels.exclusion: The age appears in the exclusion criteria.
labels.range_tail: The pattern matched the upper bound of a written range ('aged 18 to 75 years or older').
